Label: Purpose
Date: To record when the record was withdrawn.

Label: Entry Guidelines
Date: Enter a date (`2026-03-14`), or a date and time with a UTC offset or `Z` (`2026-03-14T09:30Z`, `2026-03-14T09:30:00-07:00`). Seconds and fractional seconds are optional.

Label: Commentary
Date: Follows the W3C Date and Time Format. A time without a UTC offset, a year on its own, and a year and month on their own are not valid. The date is for audit and reporting; harvesters do not use it to decide what to delete.
